correctness.rationale: For compactly supported invariant measures, integrating the three coordinate derivatives gives the stated moment identities. Variance nonnegativity yields the mean and y-second-moment bounds. Cauchy--Schwarz combined with the exact x-z second-moment ratio gives the sharp x and z bounds. Equality cases are proved by support invariance and direct solution of the equilibrium equations; the published-parameter constants simplify exactly to the stated values. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source's central engineering/mathematical purpose is amplitude/frequency control. Replacing trajectory-specific numerical amplitude summaries by a sharp, exact, all-invariant-measure second-moment envelope is mathematically substantive and directly interpretable. The equality classification shows the envelope is not merely an estimate and separates equilibrium extremizers from every genuinely recurrent non-equilibrium regime.
